title: Migration telemetry event
description: One line of migration/telemetry/events.jsonl. One JSON object per line (JSON Lines), append-only.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp, e.g. 2026-09-24T09:48:52.243Z. Written by the emitter, not the caller, wherever possible (migration/bin/emit stamps this itself).

event.description: Lifecycle event name. The dispatcher and agents are expected to use the plan's §5.1 vocabulary, but this is not a closed enum: stuck.mjs writes 'stuck' events with a 'cause', and importers may carry through other labels.

task.description: Task ID from migration/queue.yaml (e.g. 'P0-08'). Null/absent for log-wide events such as 'deadlock' or 'global_stall' stuck causes that are not about one task.

attempt.description: 1-based attempt number for this task. Required for per-attempt events (started, test_run, commit, review_verdict, merged, failed, retried); omitted for log-wide events.

model.description: Opaque model identifier as reported by the dispatcher/agent completion result. Never a human-readable model name in files this task authors; this field only carries through whatever the runtime reports.

branch.description: Git branch or worktree name the agent ran in.

sha.description: Commit SHA associated with the event (e.g. the commit a 'commit' or 'merged' event records).

duration_ms.description: Elapsed wall-clock duration in milliseconds, for events that span time (e.g. an imported agent's started->finished pair, folded onto the 'finished'-equivalent event).

tokens.description: Token count associated with the event (e.g. total tokens used by the agent call this event reports on).

reason.description: Free-text detail: first error line, review comment, blocked/failed explanation, etc. Full output belongs in a log file, not here.

signature.description: Failure signature: sha1(test full title + '\n' + first error line), as produced by record-run.mjs. Present on test_run/failed events tied to a specific failing test.

cause.description: Present only on 'stuck' events: which of the nine §5.1 stuck rules fired.

source.description: Where this line came from when it was not written directly by migration/bin/emit, e.g. 'import-workflow-journal', 'stuck.mjs', 'record-run.mjs'.

label.description: Free-form label carried through from an imported source, e.g. a workflow journal's 'task:role' agent label.

workflow_run_id.description: Identifier of the workflow run and/or agent transcript this event links to (plan §5.1: 'every event links to the agent transcript and the workflow run ID').

transcript.description: Path (relative or absolute) to the agent transcript file this event was derived from or is otherwise associated with.
